title: LanLink v1 response bodies
description: Every JSON object the v1 API returns. FastAPI declares these handlers as plain dicts, so the generated openapi.yaml cannot describe the response bodies; this file does, and tests/test_protocol_contract.py validates real server responses against it. Clients MUST ignore unknown members: additive fields are not a breaking change.

Device.description: Public identity of a LanLink node. Never contains a token or a private key.

id.description: Stable device id, a UUID4 on first run. Survives rename and address change.

name.description: Owner-chosen display name. Not unique and not an identity.

platform.description: platform.system(): Windows, Linux, Darwin, or Android for a native client.

version.description: LanLink application version, not the protocol version.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the device certificate in DER form, lowercase hex, 64 characters. Empty only when TLS is disabled.

HealthResponse.description: GET /health. The only unauthenticated endpoint besides /v1/device and /v1/pair.

DeviceResponse.description: GET /v1/device. A client polls this to see whether the owner has switched pairing on.

pairing_armed.description: True only while the owner has pairing mode on and the code has not expired.

PairResponse.description: POST /v1/pair, 200 only. The token is shown once and never again.

token.description: URL-safe base64 of 32 random bytes. The server stores only its SHA-256.

Share.description: One folder the owner explicitly added. Whole disks are never shared.

name.description: Display name. The real filesystem path is never sent.

permissions.description: Subset of r/w/d in that order. r=read, w=write, d=delete. Setting permissions always re-adds r, so in practice this is one of r, rw, rd, rwd.

available.description: False when the folder is missing right now, e.g. an unplugged drive. The share stays configured.

Entry.description: One row of a folder listing. Unfinished uploads (*.lanlink-part) are never listed.

path.description: Share-relative, POSIX separators, no leading slash. This is the value to send back as ?path=.

size.description: Bytes for a file, null for a folder.

modified_at.description: Unix epoch seconds, fractional. Not a string.

ListResponse.description: GET /v1/shares/{share_id}/list. Sorted folders-first then case-insensitive by name.

ChecksumResponse.description: GET /v1/shares/{share_id}/checksum. Computed on demand; large files take time.

PartialResponse.description: GET /v1/shares/{share_id}/partial. How many bytes of an interrupted upload survived.

received.description: Resume the PUT from this offset.

complete.description: True when the finished file already exists; a new upload under that name will be refused with 409.

size.description: Size of the finished file when complete is true, otherwise null.

path.description: Stored leaf name, which may differ from the name that was sent.

StreamUploadResponse.description: PUT /v1/files/{share_id}. complete=false when finalize=false was sent.

received.description: Total bytes now held, including everything sent before this request.

bytes.description: Present only when complete is true: the size of the published file.

name.description: Leaf name as it was actually created or renamed.

Properties.description: GET /v1/shares/{share_id}/properties. path="" describes the share root itself.

name.description: Share name when the share root was requested, otherwise the leaf name.

path.description: Empty string for the share root.

created_at.description: st_ctime: creation on Windows, inode change on POSIX.

extension.description: Lowercase, with the dot; empty for a folder.

read_only.description: Filesystem writability on the serving device, which is separate from share permissions.

OperationResponse.description: POST /v1/operations. Same-device copy or move between two shares on the responding node.

path.description: Share-relative path of the new file inside the destination share. Never absolute.

RevokeResponse.description: DELETE /v1/pairings/{client_id}. A device may only revoke itself.

Error.description: Every 4xx except 422. detail is a sentence written for a person and may be shown as-is.

ValidationError.description: 422 only, emitted by the request-model layer before any handler runs.

MdnsTxt.description: TXT record of _lanlink._tcp.local. All values are UTF-8 strings. A record without a non-empty id is ignored.

scheme.description: http appears only when the owner switched TLS off for troubleshooting.

fp.description: First 32 hex characters of the certificate fingerprint. A hint for matching, NOT sufficient to pin: pin the full 64-character fingerprint from the invite or from the certificate the peer presents, confirmed by the owner.
